title: Large Language Model Consensus and Corpus-Adaptive Topic Modeling for Classifying and Mapping Patent Innovation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Patent analytics increasingly relies on transformer representations and large language models (LLMs), yet linking conceptual classification, topic formation and interpretation requires explicit decisions about model roles and the evidence retained at each stage. In this design-oriented study, we propose and demonstrate a patent analytics pipeline that links these tasks and keeps each decision open to audit. Three LLMs separately classify each patent by novelty (radical or incremental) and innovation type (product, process, service). Radical and innovation-type labels each require two supporting votes, with Incremental used as the fallback novelty label. Topics are discovered by clustering PatentSBERTa embeddings, with parameter ranges scaled to corpus size. translated_title: 基于大语言模型共识与语料库自适应主题建模的专利创新分类与映射
translated_abstract: 专利分析日益依赖于Transformer表示和大语言模型（LLMs），然而要将概念分类、主题形成与解读结合起来，需要对模型角色以及各阶段所保留证据作出明确的决策。在这项以设计为导向的研究中，我们提出并演示了一个将这些任务串联起来的专利分析流水线，并使每一项决策都可供审计。三个大语言模型分别按新颖性（突破性或渐进性）和创新类型（产品、流程、服务）对每件专利进行分类。突破性标签和创新类型标签均需获得两张支持票，而渐进性则作为新颖性标签的兜底选项。主题通过对PatentSBERTa嵌入进行聚类来发现，其参数范围根据语料库规模进行缩放。专利专用停用词表仅在使用基于类别的词频-逆文档频率（c-TF-IDF）表示主题时才被应用，并且第二个嵌入模型……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了一个可审计的专利分析流水线，通过三个大语言模型的投票共识机制对专利的新颖性与创新类型进行分类，并结合随语料库规模自适应调参的PatentSBERTa嵌入聚类实现主题建模与解读。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an auditable patent analytics pipeline that classifies patents by novelty and innovation type through a three-LLM voting consensus, combined with corpus-size-adaptive topic modeling via clustering of PatentSBERTa embeddings.
